source_text: Χειροτονήσατε οὖν ἑαυτοῖς ἐπισκόπους καὶ διακόνους ἀξίους τοῦ κυρίου, ἄνδρας πραεῖς καὶ ἀφιλαργύρους καὶ ἀληθεῖς καὶ δεδοκιμασμένους: ὑμῖν γὰρ λειτουργοῦσι καὶ αὐτοὶ τὴν λειτουργίαν τῶν προφητῶν καὶ διδασκάλων. μὴ οὖν ὑπερίδητε αὐτούς: αὐτοὶ γάρ εἰσιν οἱ τετιμημένοι ὑμῶν μετὰ τῶν προφητῶν καὶ διδασκάλων. Ἐλέγχετε δὲ ἀλλήλους μὴ ἐν ὀργῇ, ἀλλ’ ἐν εἰρήνῃ ὡς ἔχετε ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ: καὶ παντὶ ἀστοχοῦντι κατὰ τοῦ ἑτέρου μηδεὶς λαλείτω μηδὲ παῤ ὑμῶν ἀκουέτω, ἕως οὗ μετανοήσῃ. τὰς δὲ εὐχὰς ὑμῶν καὶ τὰς ἐλεημοσύνας καὶ πάσας τὰς πράξεις οὕτω ποιήσατε, ὡς ἔχετε ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν.
pass_a_gloss: Appoint for yourselves therefore bishops and deacons worthy of the Lord, men gentle and not lovers of money and truthful and tested: for they serve you and they themselves the service of the prophets and teachers. Do not therefore overlook them: for they are the ones honored among you with the prophets and teachers. Correct one another not in anger, but in peace as you have in the gospel: and to anyone missing the mark against the other let no one speak nor let him be heard among you until he repents. The prayers of you and the acts of mercy and all the deeds do thus, as you have in the gospel of our Lord.
pass_b_english: So appoint bishops and deacons for yourselves who are worthy of the Lord: men who are gentle, not lovers of money, truthful, and proven; for they serve you, carrying out the ministry of the prophets and teachers. Do not overlook them, because they are the ones honored among you alongside the prophets and teachers.

Correct one another not in anger but in peace, just as you have it in the gospel; and let no one speak to anyone who has gone astray against another, nor let that person be heard among you, until he repents.
Offer your prayers, your acts of mercy, and all your deeds in the same way, as you have it in the gospel of our Lord.

review.notes: The translation accurately reflects the Greek text. Pass A preserves the syntax and nuances (e.g., 'missing the mark' for ἀστοχοῦντι). Pass B provides a fluent rendering that maintains the meaning and agency of the original. All clauses, including the qualifications for leaders and the instructions for communal discipline and prayer, are present in both.
